mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 4.0%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness fuels corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1700.0 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1700.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 112.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 112.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
